is_anopheles.evidence: The review discusses insecticide resistance in Anopheles vectors (e.g. An. gambiae, An. funestus) on page 3.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions target site mutations generally ('Two main mechanisms of insecticide resistance have been identified: target site mutations (such as kdr and ace)', page 5), but does not genotype any mosquitoes.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No primary mosquito genotyping was performed; no genotype counts, allele frequencies, or sample sizes are presented.

african_field_population.evidence: This is a review and research agenda paper; no mosquito field collections were conducted.

is_primary_study.evidence: The article is classified as a 'Collection Review' (page 1) outlining the malERA research agenda for insecticide and drug resistance.

sub_country_location.evidence: No primary empirical study locations are described.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No empirical mosquito collection dates exist for this review.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable as this is a review paper.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; this is a review.

assessment.summary: This article is a collection review presenting the malERA Refresh updated research agenda on drug and insecticide resistance in malaria elimination. It contains no primary empirical mosquito genotyping or bioassay data.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype target insecticide resistance markers
Does not report extractable genotype data
Does not report an African field population tested directly
